== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited and Revised Dark Side faces show armor = 3. Both the regular and high-resolution images on the Dark Side PC Errata article show defense value = 3. Advanced Rulebook v3.28 (PDF page 122) records the replacement. The 2023 Appendix A (page 126) explicitly identifies both sides.
